title: Mechanical Megataur
summary: Mechanical Megataur is a bull simulator amusement ride based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, located at the Magicland theme park (formerly known as Rainbow Magicland). The attraction consists of a large mechanical model of Megataur that wildly moves about when ridden. It was designed by the company Show Games and opened in 2015. It one of three Huntik-themed attractions at the theme park, along with the Huntik 5D and Yucatan/Huntik Spillwater rides.

sections.heading: Design
sections.wikitext:
The model was hand-crafted by the company Show Games, and designed to resemble the Titan Megataur, as he appeated in the TV series. The simulator is equipped with advanced safety features, including a rope sensor that requires the operator to pull it to start, an inflatable sensor that stops the ride if pressure is incorrect, and a door sensor.

'''Mechanical Megataur''' is a bull simulator amusement ride based on ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'', located at the ''Magicland'' theme park (formerly known as ''Rainbow Magicland''). The attraction consists of a large mechanical model of [[Megataur]] that wildly moves about when ridden.  It was designed by the company Show Games and opened in 2015. It one of three ''Huntik''-themed attractions at the theme park, along with the ''[[Huntik 5D]]'' and ''[[Yucatan|Yucatan/Huntik Spillwater]]'' rides. 

== Design == 
The model was hand-crafted by the company Show Games, and designed to resemble the Titan Megataur, as he appeated in the TV series. The simulator is equipped with advanced safety features, including a rope sensor that requires the operator to pull it to start, an inflatable sensor that stops the ride if pressure is incorrect, and a door sensor.
